title: Josh Allen 2022 Score Celebration Insert Football Card #C-JA NFL Buffalo Bills
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2022 Score Celebration Insert Football Card featuring Josh Allen of the Buffalo Bills from the National Football League (NFL). The card is made of 20 Pt. card stock and is an original Panini production. It is in English and showcases a celebration moment of Josh Allen. The card number is C-JA and it is part of the 2022 season set.
